Welcome to the class website for the 2026 software project.

## Course goals

In this project you will learn how to:

- Organize a software project with milestones and issues.
- Work as a team with Git and GitHub Classroom.
- Build and validate a C project with VS Code and CMake.
- Implement image processing features incrementally.

## Start here

1. Read [Setup](Getting-Started/Setup.qmd).
2. Follow [First Steps](Getting-Started/First-Steps.qmd).
3. Make sure your team onboarding is complete in [Workflows and Onboarding](ProjectManagement/Workflows.qmd).
4. Explore milestones in [Milestones and Issues](Features/Features.qmd).

## Source material

This website is migrated from the legacy wiki in ../projetGenieInfo_public.wiki and adapted for the 2026 workflow.
